title: Inpatient claim review assistant
brief: Design a health insurance claim adjudication assistant for inpatient hospital claims. It should read submitted policy and hospital documents, assess coverage and eligible charges, recommend or process eligible claims, and route exceptions and rejections for review. Policies can change over time and bills may include room-rent limits. Protect personal medical data, explain decisions with evidence and propose any missing rules as assumptions, not verified insurance or medical advice.

items.title: Validate policy and calculate
items.description: Match every quote byte-for-byte after fixed whitespace normalization to admitted document/page/clause; validate policy dates in code. Parse bill quantities into integer minor units via deterministic schema; ambiguous digit or currency needs staff. No model amount accepted. Proposed engine: rule pack explicitly sets admission/service-date applicability, room-day counting, rounding, room-only vs proportional-linked-charge reduction, exclusions, deductibles, copay order and remaining cover. Each must be certified H2. Synthetic rule RV1: 2 counted days, room cap 500000 minor/day; room charge 1200000 => eligible room 1000000. Other eligible charge 2000000 stays whole for room-only rule => 3000000 total. RV2 proportional rule applies 5/6 only to explicitly linked 1800000, unlinked 200000 => 1000000+1500000+200000=2700000. Round each affected line half-up to minor unit; duplicate lines flagged, not dropped silently. Unknown proration, date gaps, endorsements or accumulator freshness => review with no authoritative total. No deductible/copay assumed absent: explicit zero rules required. First release supports only explicit zero deductible and zero copay; nonzero values, mixed currency or service dates spanning rule periods route review. Apply min(calculated eligible, fresh remainingCoverMinor); remaining cover comes from an authoritative accumulator version, not document text. This recommendation reserves no benefits; fresh recheck by insurer is mandatory before settlement. Exclude clinical necessity, fraud and medically coded exclusion judgement from automated calculation; route these to staff. Monetary inputs must be nonnegative signed-64-bit integers in one trusted currency. Reject negative/overflow values. Day count must match certified admission/discharge convention; do not use a model date. Missing accumulator version or staleness => review. Accumulator guard contract: require C2 source response tenant/member/policyId/currency equals authenticated case, accumulatorVersion is a positive integer, receipt.requestId equals readRequestId, and receipt.currentVersion equals accumulatorVersion. Receipt.checkedAt must be at/after asOf and at/before calculation server time. Missing accumulatorVersion => ACCUMULATOR_VERSION_MISSING; mismatched receipt version => ACCUMULATOR_SNAPSHOT_STALE; mismatched scope/currency or absent receipt => review. Only source.remainingCoverMinor is used for min(cap); policy documents and operation.assessment are never source inputs. Assessment carries the validated source version; operation creation follows calculation, not the reverse.

items.description: PUT /staff-cases/{claim}/operations/{operationId}; authority case.write only, no payment permission. Verify authenticated scope, fresh role, current claim and rule version, full immutable payload SHA256 from stored bytes, status enum and expectedVersion at API. Unique tenant/claim/submissionRevision prevents exact duplicates; semantic duplicate candidates require human linking, never auto-merge. CAS makes only one concurrent revision succeed. 10s timeout; no blind write retry. Narrative cannot change numeric fields. Internal serialization is UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, compact separators and no nonfinite numbers; SHA256 stored bytes, not a reserialized model object. Store immutable bytes before authorizing the save. Any payload change requires new operation authorization. Ledger business identity is tenant/claim/submissionRevision. Nonmedical security telemetry remains separate from claim record writes. For DRAFT only, perform a fresh accumulator current-version query at save and require equality with assessment.accumulatorVersion; version change rejects with ACCUMULATOR_SNAPSHOT_STALE and forces new calculation/authorization. Bind approval to exact stored payload bytes/hash plus tenant/member/claim, operationId, expectedVersion and rule/accumulator versions. Two competitors need two distinct complete authorizations; an OP-1 authorization cannot authorize OP-A or OP-B. Review/cancel payloads have assessment:null and no monetary authorization.
